product_metadata.title: Tissaj Resort Collection – 3PC Twin Size Sheet Set – 100% GOTS Certified Organic Cotton Sheets Set – Sateen Weave – Smoke Grey Color
features: CERTIFIED 100% ORGANIC COTTON - These 100% organic cotton bed sheets set are GOTS Certified (Global Organic Textile Standard) and OEKO TEX Standard 100 assures a bedding that's nontoxic & chemical-free for your entire family. Enjoy breathable bed sheets which are naturally grown. These are Authentic and Certified by the highest body for being organic, ensuring your comfort and safety.

SOFT & SMOOTH – Our Sheets are of Sateen construction with extra-long staple organic cotton fiber. If you love the sheen and finish of a luxury hotel sheets then your search ends here, because life’s 33% of time is spent sleeping and that needs to be completely comfortable. We have made sure that all our sheets are absolutely flawless and smooth with our stringent quality checks. Wash in warm water separately, and tumble dry on low for long life quality.

PERFECT FIT – 15” DEEP POCKETS: Twin Fitted Sheets have a 15" drop and 360º high quality 12mm elastic to fit the mattress all around perfectly ensuring a secure snug fit. Twin Sheet Sets include a Flat Sheet - 67”x 97”, a Fitted Sheet - 39” x 75” x 15” and a Pillowcase - 21” x 31”. Our fitted sheet comes with a smart bottom tag for a hassle free fitting.

ECO-FRIENDLY PACKAGING: Arrives skillfully packaged in a Self-Fabric Organic Cotton Bag for Beautiful Gifting and easy storage. We have made our packaging reusable so that it is easy on the environment. We are also worried about the green factor of our surrounding and hence our packaging is recyclable.

100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEED – Our first goal is 100% customer satisfaction and because of that we have made our quality checks very stringent so you receive the best sheets every time. We have eliminated all the middle men to provide you best quality sheets with pocket friendly price tags. ORDER NOW!!!
